text: Mushrikeen alag aur Muwahideen alag: Is Surah-e-Mubarakah mein Mushrikeen ke amal se bezari ka elaan hai aur Allah ki ibadat ke ikhlas ka hukum hai. Go yahan khitab Makkah ke kuffar-e-Quraish se hai lekin darasal roo-e-zameen ke tamam kafir murad hain. Is ki shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke un kafiron ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha tha ke ek saal aap hamare maboodon ki ibadat karein to agle saal hum bhi Allah ki ibadat karenge. Is par yeh Surah nazil hui aur Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi-e-Barhaq (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum diya ke un ke deen se apni poori bezari ka elaan farma dein ke main tumhare in buton ko aur jin jin ko tum Allah ka shareek maan rahe ho hargiz na poojunga, go tum bhi mere Mabood-e-Barhaq Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ko na poojo. Pas 'ma' yahan par ma'ani mein 'min' ke hai. Phir dobara yahi farmaya ke main tum jaisi ibadat na karunga, tumhare mazhab par main karband nahin ho sakta, na main tumhare peeche lag sakta hoon, balkeh main to sirf apne Rab ki ibadat karunga aur woh bhi us tareeqe par jo use pasand ho aur jaise woh chahe. Isi liye farmaya ke na tum mere Rab ke ahkaam ke aage sar jhukaoge na us ki ibadat us ke farmaan ke mutabiq baja laoge, balkeh tum ne to apni taraf se tareeqe muqarrar kar liye hain. Jaise aur jagah hai: "In yattabi'oona illaz-zanna" (10:66) - yeh log sirf wahm-o-gumaan aur khwahish-e-nafsani ke peeche pade hue hain, halankeh un ke paas un ke Rab ki taraf se hidayat pahunch chuki hai. Pas Janab-e-Nabi-e-Allah Ahmad-e-Mujtaba (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne har tarah apna daaman un se chura liya aur saaf taur par un ke maboodon se aur un ki ibadat ke tareeqon se alaihadgi aur na-pasandidgi ka elaan farma diya. Zahir hai ke har aabid ka mabood hoga aur tareeqa-e-ibadat hoga. Pas Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ki ummat sirf Allah hi ki ibadat karte hain aur tareeqa-e-ibadat un ka woh hai jo Sarwar-e-Rusul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne taleem farmaya hai. Isi liye kalma-e-ikhlas "La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasoolullah" hai, yani Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur us ka raasta wahi hai jis ke batane wale Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) howein jo Allah ke Paighambar hain (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Aur Mushrikeen ke mabood bhi Allah ke siwa ghair hain aur tareeqa-e-ibadat bhi Allah ka batlaya hua nahin. Isi liye farmaya ke "Lakum deenukum waliya deen" - tumhara deen tumhare liye, mera mere liye. Jaise aur jagah hai: "Wa in kazzabooka faqul lee amali wa lakum amalukum antum baree-oona mimma a'malu wa ana baree-um mimma ta'maloon" (10:41) - yani agar yeh tujhe jhutlayein to tu keh de ke mere liye mera amal aur tumhare liye tumhara amal hai, tum mere a'maal se alag ho aur main tumhare kaamon se bezar hoon. Aur jagah farmaya: "Lana a'maluna wa lakum a'malukum" (28:55) - hamare amal hamare saath aur tumhare tumhare saath. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein is aayat ki tafseer mein hai: "Lakum deenukum" yani kufr aur "Waliya deen" yani Islam. Yeh lafz asal mein 'deeni' tha lekin chunkeh aur aayaton ka waqf noon par hai is liye is mein bhi 'ya' ko hazf kar diya, jaise "Fahuwa yahdeen" mein aur "Yasqeen" mein. Ba'az mufassireen ne kaha hai matlab yeh hai ke main ab to tumhare maboodon ki parastish karta nahin aur aage ke liye bhi tumhein na-umeed kar deta hoon ke umr bhar mein kabhi bhi yeh kufr mujh se na ho sake ga. Isi tarah na tum ab mere Allah ko poojte ho na aainda us ki ibadat karoge. Is se murad woh kuffar hain jin ka imaan na lana Allah ko maloom tha, jaise Quran mein aur jagah hai: "Wa layazeedanna katheeran minhum ma unzila ilaika mir-rabbika tughyanan wa kufra" (5:64) - yani teri taraf jo utarta hai us se un mein se aksar to sarkashi aur kufr mein badh jaate hain. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne ba'az Arabi daan hazraat se naqal kiya hai ke woh martaba is jumle ka lana sirf takeed ke liye hai, jaise "Fa inna ma'al usri yusra, inna ma'al usri yusra" (94:5-6) mein aur jaise "Latara-wunnal jaheema, thumma latara-wunnaha 'ainal yaqeen" (102:6-7) mein. Pas in dono jumlon ko do martaba laane ki hikmat mein yeh teen qaul hue: Ek to yeh ke pehle jumle se murad mabood, dusre se murad tareeqa-e-ibadat. Dusre yeh ke pehle jumle se murad haal, dusre se murad istiqbal yani aainda. Teesre yeh ke pehle jumle ki takeed dusre jumle se hai. Lekin yeh yaad rahe ke yahan ek chauthi taujeeh bhi hai jise Hazrat Imam Ibn-e-Taimiyah (R.H) apni ba'az tasneefat mein quwwat dete hain, woh yeh ke pehle to jumla-e-feliya hai aur dobara jumla-e-ismiya hai, to murad yeh hui ke na to main ghair-Allah ki ibadat karta hoon na mujh se kabhi bhi koi umeed rakh sakta hai, yani waqia ki bhi nafi hai aur shar'i taur par mumkin hone ka bhi inkaar hai. Yeh qaul bhi bahut achha hai, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Imam Abu Abdullah Shafi'i (R.H) ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke kufr ek hi millat hai, is liye Yahood Nasrani ka aur Nasrani Yahood ka waris ho sakta hai jabkeh un dono mein nasab ya sabab wirse ka paya jaye, is liye ke Islam ke siwa kufr ki jitni raahein hain woh sab baatil hone mein ek hi hain. Hazrat Imam Ahmad (R.H) aur un ke muwafiqeen ka mazhab is ke bar-khilaf hai ke na Yahoodi Nasrani ka waris ho sakta hai na Nasrani Yahood ka, kyunkeh hadees hai: "Do mukhtalif mazhab wale aapas mein ek dusre ke waris nahin ho sakte." Surah Kafiroon ki tafseer khatam hui, Falhamdullilah ala ihsanihi.

Isi tarah na tum ab mere Allah ko poojte ho na aainda us ki ibadat karoge. Is se murad woh kuffar hain jin ka imaan na lana Allah ko maloom tha, jaise Quran mein aur jagah hai: "Wa layazeedanna katheeran minhum ma unzila ilaika mir-rabbika tughyanan wa kufra" (5:64) - yani teri taraf jo utarta hai us se un mein se aksar to sarkashi aur kufr mein badh jaate hain. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne ba'az Arabi daan hazraat se naqal kiya hai ke woh martaba is jumle ka lana sirf takeed ke liye hai, jaise "Fa inna ma'al usri yusra, inna ma'al usri yusra" (94:5-6) mein aur jaise "Latara-wunnal jaheema, thumma latara-wunnaha 'ainal yaqeen" (102:6-7) mein. Pas in dono jumlon ko do martaba laane ki hikmat mein yeh teen qaul hue: Ek to yeh ke pehle jumle se murad mabood, dusre se murad tareeqa-e-ibadat. Dusre yeh ke pehle jumle se murad haal, dusre se murad istiqbal yani aainda. Teesre yeh ke pehle jumle ki takeed dusre jumle se hai. Lekin yeh yaad rahe ke yahan ek chauthi taujeeh bhi hai jise Hazrat Imam Ibn-e-Taimiyah (R.H) apni ba'az tasneefat mein quwwat dete hain, woh yeh ke pehle to jumla-e-feliya hai aur dobara jumla-e-ismiya hai, to murad yeh hui ke na to main ghair-Allah ki ibadat karta hoon na mujh se kabhi bhi koi umeed rakh sakta hai, yani waqia ki bhi nafi hai aur shar'i taur par mumkin hone ka bhi inkaar hai. Yeh qaul bhi bahut achha hai, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Imam Abu Abdullah Shafi'i (R.H) ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke kufr ek hi millat hai, is liye Yahood Nasrani ka aur Nasrani Yahood ka waris ho sakta hai jabkeh un dono mein nasab ya sabab wirse ka paya jaye, is liye ke Islam ke siwa kufr ki jitni raahein hain woh sab baatil hone mein ek hi hain. Hazrat Imam Ahmad (R.H) aur un ke muwafiqeen ka mazhab is ke bar-khilaf hai ke na Yahoodi Nasrani ka waris ho sakta hai na Nasrani Yahood ka, kyunkeh hadees hai: "Do mukhtalif mazhab wale aapas mein ek dusre ke waris nahin ho sakte." Surah Kafiroon ki tafseer khatam hui, Falhamdullilah ala ihsanihi.

Mushrikeen alag aur Muwahideen alag: Is Surah-e-Mubarakah mein Mushrikeen ke amal se bezari ka elaan hai aur Allah ki ibadat ke ikhlas ka hukum hai. Go yahan khitab Makkah ke kuffar-e-Quraish se hai lekin darasal roo-e-zameen ke tamam kafir murad hain. Is ki shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke un kafiron ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha tha ke ek saal aap hamare maboodon ki ibadat karein to agle saal hum bhi Allah ki ibadat karenge. Is par yeh Surah nazil hui aur Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi-e-Barhaq (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum diya ke un ke deen se apni poori bezari ka elaan farma dein ke main tumhare in buton ko aur jin jin ko tum Allah ka shareek maan rahe ho hargiz na poojunga, go tum bhi mere Mabood-e-Barhaq Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ko na poojo. Pas 'ma' yahan par ma'ani mein 'min' ke hai. Phir dobara yahi farmaya ke main tum jaisi ibadat na karunga, tumhare mazhab par main karband nahin ho sakta, na main tumhare peeche lag sakta hoon, balkeh main to sirf apne Rab ki ibadat karunga aur woh bhi us tareeqe par jo use pasand ho aur jaise woh chahe. Isi liye farmaya ke na tum mere Rab ke ahkaam ke aage sar jhukaoge na us ki ibadat us ke farmaan ke mutabiq baja laoge, balkeh tum ne to apni taraf se tareeqe muqarrar kar liye hain. Jaise aur jagah hai: "In yattabi'oona illaz-zanna" (10:66) - yeh log sirf wahm-o-gumaan aur khwahish-e-nafsani ke peeche pade hue hain, halankeh un ke paas un ke Rab ki taraf se hidayat pahunch chuki hai. Pas Janab-e-Nabi-e-Allah Ahmad-e-Mujtaba (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne har tarah apna daaman un se chura liya aur saaf taur par un ke maboodon se aur un ki ibadat ke tareeqon se alaihadgi aur na-pasandidgi ka elaan farma diya. Zahir hai ke har aabid ka mabood hoga aur tareeqa-e-ibadat hoga. Pas Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ki ummat sirf Allah hi ki ibadat karte hain aur tareeqa-e-ibadat un ka woh hai jo Sarwar-e-Rusul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne taleem farmaya hai. Isi liye kalma-e-ikhlas "La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasoolullah" hai, yani Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur us ka raasta wahi hai jis ke batane wale Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) howein jo Allah ke Paighambar hain (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Aur Mushrikeen ke mabood bhi Allah ke siwa ghair hain aur tareeqa-e-ibadat bhi Allah ka batlaya hua nahin. Isi liye farmaya ke "Lakum deenukum waliya deen" - tumhara deen tumhare liye, mera mere liye. Jaise aur jagah hai: "Wa in kazzabooka faqul lee amali wa lakum amalukum antum baree-oona mimma a'malu wa ana baree-um mimma ta'maloon" (10:41) - yani agar yeh tujhe jhutlayein to tu keh de ke mere liye mera amal aur tumhare liye tumhara amal hai, tum mere a'maal se alag ho aur main tumhare kaamon se bezar hoon. Aur jagah farmaya: "Lana a'maluna wa lakum a'malukum" (28:55) - hamare amal hamare saath aur tumhare tumhare saath.
